When it comes to selling ebooks and digital downloads, you have several options for payment processing. Gumroad, a popular platform, charges a 10% commission on every sale, while NOWPayments offers a more cost-effective solution with a 0.5% fee. In addition, NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script, allowing for automated delivery of digital products without relying on third-party platforms. This means that you have full control over your sales process and can scale your business more efficiently.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and other platforms often face restrictions in certain countries, making it difficult for authors to sell their ebooks and digital downloads. NOWPayments, on the other hand, is not bound by these restrictions and can be used in any country, making it an ideal solution for authors who face payment processing challenges. Additionally, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving authors more flexibility when it comes to accepting payments.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed, fees, and real costs are critical factors to consider. Gumroad's 10% commission may seem reasonable, but it adds up quickly, especially for high-volume sales. NOWPayments, on the other hand, charges a flat 0.5% fee, making it a more cost-effective solution. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, making a significant impact on your bottom line.
